findings.text: This archived landed record names benchmarks/incomplete_third_kind.py as the driver of a recorded measurement but carries no revision number, so the fragment's claim at docs/evidence/fragments/code-reuse-and-hot-path/bench-scripts-delete.html:20 that every docs/ reference carries the revision it ran at is false for this record; the plan's cited-driver decision permits deletion only when the citing record names a revision that resolves, so this driver's deletion is not covered by that decision, although git history retains the file.

The summary row restored: cited by kept code or a kept record reads 54 files and 21657 lines, but the two restores at line 56 carry 442 lines, so 54 restores total 22099 lines; the 21657 cell fails to reconcile with the 185431 deletable total (163332+21657=184989), though the file counts and the net total are correct.

Four files under scripts/iron_limb_production (comparison.py, figure.py, negative_control_west.py, refinement.py) and scripts/prototypes/polygon_stable_evaluator/production_pair.py were deleted although both directories are the declared write scopes of sibling nodes of this same plan (peer_scopes ilf-control-receipt-rebuild and moment-row-z-gradient); neither node has a live run and no kept file names these paths, but each sibling will find its declared scope partly removed.

orientation_write_paths entry 1 is the unevaluated expression docs/evidence/fragments/code-reuse-and-hot-path/ + bench-scripts-delete + .html rather than a path, so the node's declared write set does not parse as a list of paths.

Collection parity is recorded at e75324fc6, five commits before the reviewed head, and the plan decision's import sweep of every remaining module has no recorded run; the head-level claim that the tree collects rests on the fact that the later commits only restore files, not on a head-level collection pass.

verdicts.diff: Read all sixteen commits 348ed92c..e1bc21735: seven deletion batches of 54/54/42/113/197/148/8 files each under 30k lines, two restored siblings, repair rounds of 52 and 5 files, and five record commits; the net is 562 deletions and one added record fragment with zero changes under tests/, nova/, pyproject.toml and uv.lock.
verdicts.done_when: The done_when requires every deleted path absent and unnamed at the head, a zero-added-failure suite delta on all_debug, and an accurate lines-removed record; the plan's deletion-gate decision replaces the full-suite delta with the absence check, collection parity and identical failure ids on a focused set, each of which is recorded, and I reproduced the absence result independently (0 hits for 562 paths across the non-docs tree).
verdicts.goal: The goal is to apply the census delete and merge verdicts to benchmarks/ and scripts/ in reviewable batches with no added suite failures; the landed diff removes 562 of the 718 verdict paths in seven batches and removes all three merge duplicates, which are byte-identical to their merge_into targets at the base, while 102 paths are withheld and 54 restored with stated reasons.
verdicts.manifest: Read; it records status complete with 562 deleted paths and 163332 lines and names four gate logs plus three repair-check logs, but its orientation_write_paths entry 1 is an unevaluated string concatenation rather than a path and the focused arms are carried without baseline_suite/after_suite JSON blocks.
verdicts.write_paths: The declared set is the record fragment, its figures directory and the two repaired sources; every deletion in the diff lies under benchmarks/ or scripts/ and is the goal itself, and five deleted files fall inside two sibling nodes' declared peer write scopes.
